node.title: Surviving Capability: Why the Field Celebrates What the Theory Condemns
node.reading: Why the field celebrates what the theory condemns. The practitioner’s notes praise the informal taxi swarm, the analog protocol, the constraint-born workaround — exactly the off-map divergence the theory treats as pathology. It looks like the corpus contradicts itself. It does not, and the answer is in three things I lived: two transport systems — one that repaired its map, one that froze — and Uber, which proves the point by changing the technology and nothing else. The field never celebrated the inefficiency. It celebrated the capability that had not yet been lost.
node.readingSummary: Why the field celebrates what the theory condemns.

relations: A capability-loss study should include useful survivors, genuine redundancies and documented losses rather than selecting only successful informal adaptations.
El relato de supervivencia puede tener sesgo de selección; no estima por sí solo frecuencia o causalidad del Attribution Gap.
A reversible provisional declaration can help discover a route between current and target states, while keeping exploration separate from an irreversible ownership or retirement decision.
Double-map deadlock permanece como constructo propuesto; no se demuestra incomputabilidad formal por la falta de un mapa.
The minimum-information lens turns an attractive target into an actionable transition question: what must be known, decided and authorized for the next move to become possible?
La ficha propuesta no asegura una solución Pareto-mejor ni sustituye negociación, financiación o requisitos regulatorios.
The transfer-compensation example shows why network value may require funding the contributing node even when its local ledger understates the benefit it creates elsewhere.
La analogía no verifica cifras históricas del fondo ni prueba que toda línea deficitaria cree valor neto para la red.
The survivor lens sharpens value discovery: identify the useful capability and its carriers before deciding which legacy form should remain, change or disappear.
Encontrar valor en un legado no legitima conservar todo su coste, riesgo o estructura de atribución.
Rationalization should distinguish the removable implementation from the useful function it carries, with an accepted continuity or replacement path before retirement.
Es una propuesta de integración del criterio; no atribuye al producto una validación causal de Attribution Gap.
The companion bridge note qualifies Lesson 6: preserve the capability that works under constraint, while testing its architecture rather than treating scarcity itself as a design advantage.
La aclaración editorial no borra la utilidad descrita del caso ni aporta una comparación experimental de soportes.
The network example suggests a JUBAP leverage point in the funding and transfer rule itself: make the contributing node sustainable so the wider service can work.
Es aplicación propuesta de la lectura; no implica que JUBAP diseñara la reforma histórica de Barcelona.
Surviving Capability helps separate the useful function that integration should retain from the compensatory structure that may still need repair.
No convertir precariedad, carga invisible o incumplimiento en virtud por el solo hecho de que el sistema siga funcionando.

Comparan qué capacidad puede seguir operando cuando cambian quienes la sostienen.
Preservar una capacidad exige que pueda seguir practicándose. Surviving Capability permite contrastar ese criterio con lo que queda operativo después de una intervención.
La imagen del siguiente árbol centra la atención en la capacidad de producir después. La lectura empresarial pregunta qué pueden seguir haciendo los destinatarios cuando termina el apoyo inicial.
